_comment: The fixed half of every cover letter, every Language in one file: each value is a language map {"de": ..., "en": ...} (a plain string is used in every Language). Markdown allowed. The specific half lives in applications/<slug>/cover-letter.json. Order in the letter: letter.intro, fixed.about_me, letter.body, fixed.closing; letter.intro (one sentence) and the first about_me paragraph form one paragraph. Subject: cover-letter.json's own "subject" wins; otherwise subject_with_reference when posting.reference is set, else subject_default. Salutation: cover-letter.json's own "salutation" wins; otherwise salutation_named[posting.contact.salutation] ("_" when the title is unknown) with {salutation} {first_name} {last_name}; otherwise salutation_default. email_body: the paragraphs of the covering email when the employer takes applications by email (form_url mailto:); placeholders {role}, {company}, {reference}.

subject_with_reference.en: Application for the position of {role}, ref. {reference}

de: Zurzeit absolviere ich den Master in Applied Information and Data Science an der Hochschule Luzern. Neben dem Studium arbeite ich als Werkstudentin im Bereich Data Analytics, wo ich Reports automatisiere und Dashboards für das Controlling aufbaue.
en: I am currently pursuing a Master's degree in Applied Information and Data Science at the Lucerne University of Applied Sciences. Alongside my studies I work as a working student in data analytics, automating reports and building dashboards for the controlling team.

de: Ich freue mich, Sie in einem persönlichen Gespräch kennenzulernen.
en: I would be delighted to discuss my application with you in person.

de: Gerne bewerbe ich mich als {role}. Mein Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse finden Sie im Anhang.
Ich freue mich von Ihnen zu hören.
en: I would like to apply for the position of {role}. Please find my cover letter, CV and references attached.
I look forward to hearing from you.
